reasoning: For every integer n, Fermat's little theorem gives n^7 ≡ n (mod 7), so 7 divides n^7−n. Modulo 2, n^7−n is even because n^7 and n have the same parity. Modulo 3, if 3 divides n then it divides n^7−n; otherwise n ≡ ±1 (mod 3), and n^7 ≡ n (mod 3). Thus 2, 3, and 7 all divide n^7−n. Since they are pairwise coprime, their product 42 divides n^7−n.
